title: The Forest That Stayed Green
intro: This quiz follows Aria and Mateo as they learn why evergreen trees stay green and how their leaves help them survive tough weather.

questions.prompt: Why do evergreen trees stay green throughout the year?
choices: They grow new leaves every morning
They keep many of their leaves for several years
Their leaves are made of wood
questions.explanation: Evergreen trees stay green because they keep many of their leaves for several years.

questions.prompt: Which group contains only evergreen trees mentioned in the story?
choices: Pine, spruce, fir, cedar, and redwood
questions.explanation: Pine, spruce, fir, cedar, and redwood are evergreen trees mentioned in the story.

questions.prompt: How are spruce needles described in the story?
questions.explanation: Spruce needles are described as shorter and sharper.

questions.prompt: What is special about cedar leaves?
choices: They look like tiny green scales
questions.explanation: Cedar leaves look like tiny green scales.

questions.prompt: How do narrow needles and a waxy coating help evergreen trees?
choices: They help the trees catch insects
They help the trees save water and survive cold or dry weather
They make the trees grow fruit
They help the trees change color in autumn
questions.explanation: Narrow needles and a waxy coating help evergreen trees save water and survive cold or dry weather.
